structure.description: The four project_sunroof files are geographic partitions with identical columns; region_name changes meaning with city, county, postal-code, or state granularity.
us_electricity_prices and us_generation align naturally on year, month, and state, but add sector versus producer-type/energy-source dimensions.
sustainable_energy and owid_co2 are country-year panels; country names may require normalization, while iso_code is available only in owid_co2.
In steel_electricity, date and NSM describe the same quarter-hour timeline; calendar labels and Load_Type are categorical annotations.

uncertainties: Textual NULL values and blank fields occur in project_sunroof and should be parsed as missing, not geographic names or zeros.
Units documented here follow column labels and common source conventions; a few Project Sunroof field definitions are inferred from names.
owid_co2 contains aggregate regions as well as countries, and coverage differs substantially by indicator and year.
annotation_notes: High-level relationships and field semantics were derived only from the public file names, headers, and sampled values.
Each ordinary source column is listed separately; no task-specific metric or filter was added.
